description: Wingspan main window. Every entry must justify itself against a hostile filename rendered in the UI. No plugin permission. `reveal_folder` is the one command that takes a path from JS, and it answers only for an allow-list of three folders the app already knows. No command takes a path that decides what the app executes or where it reads a secret. The Model tab's three (`chain_expirations`, `option_chain`, `set_model_contracts`) take no path and no secret and execute nothing: two read the option chain, the third adds contracts to the quote universe.
